plans.note: Section 11.5 (p0572) is a mutual consequential/indirect damages waiver with carve-outs (fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence, plus at least one further lettered exception). No monetary aggregate cap surfaced; worker should read the full 11.5 carve-out list and confirm whether any cap exists elsewhere, and check mutuality and whether indemnity/confidentiality breaches are carved out.

Mutual indemnities: 11.1 to Harpoon Indemnitees (p0559 — our indemnity, keep narrow) and 11.2 to AbbVie Indemnitees (p0560 — Harpoon's indemnity). Notice/defense mechanics at 11.3-11.4 (p0561, p0562, p0564, p0568). Compare scope of p0560 (third-party IP, Harpoon negligence/breach) against p0559 and check control of defense and settlement consent.

Section 5.8 (p0367-p0369) binds Harpoon only ('Harpoon shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to ... develop, commercialize ... any Competing Product'), which benefits us and should not be flagged. Paginate sec-5-2 to confirm no reciprocal restriction on AbbVie; review Competitor definition (p0102) and CoC provision (p0273).

Exclusivity at Section 5.8 (p0367-p0369) runs against Harpoon; licences to AbbVie at 5.1 (p0351-p0356) are exclusive in our favour with Harpoon retained rights at 5.6.1 (p0363). Confirm no reciprocal sourcing/exclusivity duty on AbbVie and that the Segregate/acquirer carve-out at p0369 preserves our rights.
No hits for most favored/most favoured/no less favorable/best-terms language across multiple query variants. No MFN burdening us appears to exist; treat as not applicable rather than a deviation.

No hits for solicit/hire/recruit/non-solicitation across several phrasings. Rule appears inapplicable to this development and option agreement; flag only if a worker encounters personnel provisions while reading Articles 3 or 13.

Section 12.3 'Additional Termination Rights by AbbVie' (p0590) is our convenience right, in entirety or country-by-country; read for notice period and payment consequences. Harpoon's rights appear limited to material breach (12.2, p0584-p0586) and insolvency (12.4, p0591) — confirm Harpoon has no convenience right.

Section 12.1.1 (p0582) runs from the Effective Date until (likely) expiry of the last Royalty Term rather than a fixed term with auto-renewal; no 'automatically renew'/'renewal term' language found. Confirm Term structure and note auto-renewal mechanics are inapplicable rather than missing.

Section 13.6 (p0651-p0653) selects Delaware law — an accepted jurisdiction — with jurisdiction and service of process. Section 13.7 (p0654-p0657) is a tiered process with an arbitration election (13.7.3); read p0655-p0657 to determine whether arbitration is optional/domestic (acceptable) or mandatory/foreign-seated (deviation). Internal JGC escalation at 2.2.3 (p0264) is related.

Section 13.4 Assignment (p0647-p0648) plus successors language; Section 13.2 'Change in Control of Harpoon' (p0643 and sec-13.2.2) is a counterparty-CoC regime likely favourable to us. Confirm AbbVie may assign to Affiliates and successors without consent; check CoC consequences at p0273 and p0369 and the assignment reference at p0415.

Section 7.1 Ownership (p0426-p0433): 7.1.1 Ownership of Technology (p0427, subject to 3.8.2(c)), 7.1.2 Joint IP (p0429), 7.1.4 Assignments (p0431-p0433), further assurances (p0445). Verify AbbVie owns AbbVie-generated IP and the Regulatory Documentation/Clinical Data it funds, that joint ownership is workable, and that no AbbVie background IP or data is assigned to Harpoon.

Grants to AbbVie at 5.1 (p0351-p0356) including rights of reference, sublicensing at 5.3 (p0359), confirmatory patent licence at 5.7 (p0365), and the License Option grant at 3.2.3 (p0300). Confirm coverage of Affiliates, Sublicensees, Distributors and contractors, that the licence is not revocable at will, and review the grant back at 5.2 (p0358) and retained rights at 5.6.1 (p0363).

Section 6.11 Audit (p0419) runs against AbbVie and our Affiliates/Sublicensees — read for frequency, notice, scope, cost allocation and the error threshold shifting cost. Section 6.12 Audit Dispute / Audit Expert (p0420, definition p0075) governs disputes. Assess against the preferred position of infrequent, notified, vendor-cost audits.

No liquidated damages, penalty or termination-fee language surfaced. Closest items are late-payment interest (6.10, p0418) and non-refundable upfront/milestone payments (p0378, p0379, p0386), which are ordinary consideration rather than penalties. Confirm the interest rate is standard and note no LD provision exists.

Mutual reps at 10.1 (p0521), Harpoon-specific reps at 10.2 (p0527, schedule-qualified), Harpoon covenants (sec-10.3), AbbVie covenants (sec-10.4), disclaimer at 10.5 (p0557). Paginate sec-10-2 for IP title/non-infringement, no-debarment and compliance warranties; check whether they are as-of-Effective-Date only and whether 10.5 undercuts the express warranties.

Section 11.6 (p0573-p0579) requires each Party to carry minimum coverages (workers' comp/employer's liability, general liability; limits redacted), primary/non-contributory language, and an AbbVie self-insurance right at 11.6.3 (p0579). Confirm product liability/clinical trial coverage is included and our self-insurance right is unconditional.

No minimum purchase, take-or-pay, shortfall or requirements language found across multiple query sets; the only 'minimum' hits are insurance limits (p0573-p0577). Diligence/Commercially Reasonable Efforts obligations are a separate commercial matter and should not be double-flagged here.

Post-termination mechanics at Sections 12.6/12.7 (p0600, p0623-p0627: Harpoon Reversion Products, AbbVie Reversion IP, transfer of materials/data at p0626-p0627) and Section 9.7 Return of Confidential Information (p0517). These run largely toward Harpoon on reversion; assess whether AbbVie obtains adequate wind-down/sell-off rights and return of our data, and read the redacted obligations at p0626-p0627 closely.
